semantic_label: cursor buffer emit: advance the cursor by the 0x18 element stride and copy one element, or hand the full buffer to the grow-and-emit port when the cursor reached the limit

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x18; the receiver is spilled to EBP-0x14

native_reads: PUSH EAX at 0x0041e8ee for the copy port
PUSH ECX at 0x0041e908 for the grow port
stack_arguments.note: the word is used as an opaque source pointer, not as a count

abi.return_contract: void; the body never writes EAX and ends at 0x0041e91b with RET 0x4

instruction_list: 0x0041e8bf MOV EDX,[EAX+0x4] / CMP EDX,[ECX+0x8] / JNC 0x0041e905  (unsigned cursor >= limit takes the grow path)
0x0041e8c7 saved = cursor; MOV [ECX+0x4],EAX+0x18  (cursor advanced before the copy)
0x0041e8e5 CMP [EBP-0x4],0x0 / JZ 0x0041e8fc  (a null saved cursor stores a null result)
0x0041e8eb PUSH argument / MOV ECX,[EBP-0x4] / CALL 0x00511140 / MOV [EBP-0x18],EAX
0x0041e905 MOV ECX,[EBP+0x8] / PUSH ECX / MOV EAX,[EDX+0x4] / PUSH EAX / MOV ECX,[EBP-0x14] / CALL 0x00424010

mechanics: compare the cursor at +0x04 against the limit at +0x08 with an unsigned JNC
on the grow path push the argument and the unadvanced cursor, then the receiver, into port 0x00424010
on the copy path save the pre-advance cursor into a local and store cursor + 0x18 back to +0x04
advance the cursor before the element copy, not after
skip the copy port entirely when the saved cursor is zero and stage a null result instead
otherwise call port 0x00511140 with ECX equal to the saved cursor and the argument pushed as the source
the copy port return value is computed into EBP-0x18 and never read afterwards
no receiver field other than +0x04 is written
